text:
ella: Quick vendor-liaison ask — we need firm ETAs and SKU naming for marketplace handoff. Specifically: H200 driver/firmware, MI300 microcode/ECC fix, Gaudi runtime packaging. Also need embargo windows for joint announce. Can @mike, @sanjay and @olivia help pull vendor dates and reserve SKU placeholders? Thanks.

mike: On it. Which vendors do we need? Nvidia (H200/H100), AMD (MI300), Habana/Intel (Gaudi). I can ping vendor PMs and ask for RTD + test images.

sanjay: FYI I already chatted with Nvidia yesterday. Short summary — they've promised H100->H200 carrier driver by 04/05, but flagged a potential firmware regression for burst workloads. MI300 patch ETA tentative 04/20. Gaudi driver packaging is green — partner will push container next week.

olivia: Important: marketplace needs canonical SKU names now. Propose pattern: `redwood-HW-<model>-<variant>-v<major>` e.g., `redwood-HW-H200-standard-v1`. Thoughts?

ryan: +1 on naming. Also need embargo windows for co-announcement. Vendor legal asked for a 72h embargo before external press. If we aim for week of 04/25, vendors want embargo 04/22-04/25.

ella: Ok — action items: 1) Mike to confirm H200 firmware regression scope and workaround; 2) Sanjay to get MI300 ECC test pass date; 3) Olivia to create SKU placeholder list; 4) Ryan to propose embargo calendar and press POC. I'll reserve tentative announce week 04/25.

mike: I'll open a vendor follow-up thread and tag vendor contacts. Will also ask for certified kernel/syscalls matrix.

olivia: I'll create placeholder SKUs in marketplace tracker in the morning. naming PR in #marketplace later today.

deploy-bot: Created issue MDKT-6724 in marketplace-tracker: "reserve-SKUs-H100-H200-MI300-Gaudi" — https://phabricator.redwood/MDKT-6724

sanjay: vendor update (copied): "H200 firmware fix currently in validation cluster; if validation passes by 04/03 we can ship 04/06. MI300 microcode ETA 04/18-04/22 pending silicon tests." Will update if times shift.

ryan: Let's not commit public dates until we have signed off on the regression mitigation. Suggest internal freeze on external comms until 04/10.

ella: Agreed. Tagging @marketplace-team to hold off public SKU pages until we confirm. Thanks all :pray:

mike: 👍 I'll post a short readout in partnerships channel after vendor confirmations.
